06 NON-COMPETITION
For a period of twenty-four (24) months following the termination of your employment for any reason whatsoever, you shall not directly or indirectly engage in, or be employed by, any business that competes with the Company anywhere in India.
heading: 06 NON-COMPETITION

05 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All inventions, discoveries, improvements and works of authorship conceived or created by you during the term of your employment, whether during or outside the usual hours of work and whether on or off the premises of the Company, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company. You hereby irrevocably assign to the Company all right, title and interest therein, including all moral rights.
heading: 05 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

04 CONFIDENTIALITY
You shall keep confidential all information relating to the Company in perpetuity, whether or not such information is or becomes publicly available.
heading: 04 CONFIDENTIALITY

03 NOTICE PERIOD
The Employee shall give ninety (90) days written notice of resignation. The Company may terminate this employment on thirty (30) days notice.
heading: 03 NOTICE PERIOD

07 RESTRICTIONS DURING EMPLOYMENT
While employed by the Company you shall not engage in any other paid employment without written consent. This restriction applies only during your employment and ends on your last working day.
heading: 07 RESTRICTIONS DURING EMPLOYMENT

text:
04 CONFIDENTIALITY
You shall keep confidential all non-public information of the Company for a period of three (3) years following the end of your employment. This obligation does not apply to information that is already in the public domain or that becomes public through no fault of yours.
heading: 04 CONFIDENTIALITY

text:
03 NOTICE PERIOD
Either party may terminate this employment by giving thirty (30) (30) days written notice to the other. The notice period is the same for both the Company and the Employee.
heading: 03 NOTICE PERIOD

text:
07 TERMINATION
The Company may terminate your employment at any time with immediate effect for any act or omission which in the sole opinion of the Company is detrimental to the best interests of the Company.
heading: 07 TERMINATION

08 GOVERNING LAW
Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration before a sole arbitrator appointed by the Company, seated in the city of the Company's registered office.
heading: 08 GOVERNING LAW

08 GOVERNING LAW
This letter is governed by the laws of India. Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration before a sole arbitrator appointed jointly by both parties, seated in the city where you are based.
heading: 08 GOVERNING LAW

02 SERVICE COMMITMENT
You shall serve the Company for a minimum period of three (3) years from the date of joining. In the event you resign before completing this period, you shall pay the Company a sum of Rs. 5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakh only) as liquidated damages, recoverable as a debt.
heading: 02 SERVICE COMMITMENT

text:
06 TERMINATION FOR CAUSE
The Company may terminate your employment for cause, which means only the following: conviction of a criminal offence, proven fraud, or wilful breach of the confidentiality clause. In each case the Company shall give you written notice of the specific ground and thirty (30) days to remedy it where the breach is capable of remedy.
heading: 06 TERMINATION FOR CAUSE

text:
02 PROBATION
You will be on probation for three (3) months from the date of joining. On satisfactory completion the Company shall confirm your employment in writing. Probation shall not be extended beyond a further three months.
heading: 02 PROBATION

05 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
Work product created by you during working hours and in the course of your duties for the Company shall vest in the Company. Work created by you before joining the Company, and work created outside working hours that is unrelated to the business of the Company, remains yours. Nothing in this clause affects your moral rights as an author.
